newsitem.title: USA: Marquette Medical adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Marquette Medical adopts rights plan.

text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc said Friday its board had approved a shareholder rights plan, declaring a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right for each common share outstanding.
Marquette also reached agreement with Chairman Michael Cudahy on a previously announced plan to swap the executive's 26,250,000 Class C shares for 262,500 Class A shares.
The plan to swap Cudahy's Class C shares, thereby retiring this class of stock, for class A shares was announced previously.
Marquette said the rights plan was not adopted in response to any specific effort to acquire control of the company, and directors are not aware of any such effort.
It said the plan would not prevent a takeover but would encourage anyone seeking to acquire the company to negotiate with the board prior to attempting a takeover.
The rights are exercisable if a person or group acquires 20 percent or more of the company's common stock or announces a tender offer.
Each right entitles the holder to buy 0.01 share of a new series of preferred stock at an exercise price of $80.
The dividend distribution will be made on January 3, payable to stockholders of record on that date. Rights will expire on December 18, 2006.
